_comment: e2r MCP server — Claude Code config. Copy this whole file to .mcp.json in your project root (project scope) or merge the "e2r" entry into ~/.claude.json (user scope). Restart Claude Code after adding it. "e2r" must resolve on PATH (cargo install --path converters/electron/crates/e2r-cli); if it doesn't, replace "e2r" with the absolute path to the cargo-installed binary, usually ~/.cargo/bin/e2r.
